title: 第688章 似幻似真第687章 前夜
lines: 第688章似幻似真
望着眼前这片奇幻的虚空，已经失去了形体的四人在用神念交流着。
问君：“这是更高维度的世界？”
白牧野：“应该是，咱们还要在这里熟悉一下这世界的法则才能凝聚出实体来……”
这世界到处充斥着斑斓的光芒，颜色绚丽到令人难以置信。
人间的色彩，无非赤橙黄绿青蓝紫黑白，再加上这些颜色的变种。
更多则是日月星辰和无尽幽暗的宇宙虚空。
但这地方，根本看不见任何日月星辰，只有美到令人难以呼吸的各种色彩。
众人刚一进来，就发现自己的身体全部消失掉了。
这种感觉很难去解释，就像是三维立体世界的生灵突然间进入到二维的扁平世界一样。
当然，那个是降维，他们这是升维。
时间在这里几乎完全失去了意义。
即便是刚刚进来，但众人也能一下子感受到那种跟之前完全不同的法则力量。
想要让这个世界变成之前世界的样子，首先，他们四个必须要熟悉这里的法则。
也就是，这里的道。
“看似平和，实则充满危机，”林子衿轻声说，“我们甚至无法在这里感应到敌人的接近。”
“也许没有敌人。”彩衣道。
“你们说，那些域外天魔为什么不来这？他们既然早就知道这个世界有重建六道轮回的材料，为什么他们不来这里获取？”白牧野一边感悟着这个世界的法则，一边问道。
“或许，他们不敢来吧？”问君有些不确定的说道：“你们难道没发现，这个世界里面，感受不到任何生机吗？”
“是的，的确感受不到，但这并不代表不存在。”白牧野回答道。
在这种没有时间概念的高纬度世界里，众人也不知过去多久，也许很久，也许只是一刹那。
当这个世界的景象在几人眼前终于发生变化的时候，几个人……全都有点被惊呆了。
他们站在一条繁华的街上，街上车水马龙，人流汹涌，天空中有各种飞行器不断飞过，地面的路上也有无数的车子疾驰而过。
两旁林立的高楼高耸入云。
“这是……人间？”问君皱着眉头。
“幻象。”白牧野说着，身上直接有一道符文飞出，迅速飞到高天之上，瞬间放大到遮天蔽日的程度。
轰！
所有一切，全部消失了。
接着，几人眼前一变，他们出现在一片荒凉无比的大漠中。
就连一身法力仿佛都被彻底封印住了一般。
头顶烈日炎炎，脚下黄沙无边。
白牧野继续用符文破掉。
随后，各种各样的文明场景，各种各样的世界，走马灯一般的出现在众人眼前。
当小白接连破掉几十个场景之后，眼前再度恢复到之前那色彩斑斓的景象。
就连白牧野都有点无语了。
这世界的法则太奇怪了！
他也终于有点明白，为什么域外天魔不来这里了。
这里有没有生灵？
按照人间的法则来看，应该是没有的。

Chapter 688: Illusion and Reality
Looking at the fantastic void in front of them, the four people who had lost their bodies were communicating with their spiritual thoughts.
Question: "Is this a higher-dimensional world?"
Bai Muye: "Probably, we still need to familiarize ourselves with the laws of this world here before we can condense the entity..."
The world is filled with dazzling lights, and the colors are incredibly brilliant.
The colors in the world are nothing more than red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, black and white, plus variations of these colors.
More are the sun, moon, stars and the endless dark void of the universe.
But in this place, you can't see any sun, moon or stars at all, only various colors that are so beautiful that it's hard to breathe.
As soon as everyone came in, they found that their bodies had completely disappeared.
This feeling is difficult to explain, as if a creature in a three-dimensional world suddenly entered a two-dimensional flat world.
Of course, that is dimensionality reduction, and theirs is dimensionality enhancement.
Time has almost completely lost its meaning here.
Even if they just came in, everyone could immediately feel the power of the law that was completely different from before.
If they want to make this world what it was before, first of all, the four of them must be familiar with the laws here.
That is, the Tao here.
"It looks peaceful, but it's actually full of dangers," Lin Zijin said softly, "We can't even sense the enemy's approach here."
"Maybe there are no enemies." Caiyi said.
"Tell me, why don't those extraterrestrial demons come here? Since they have known for a long time that this world has the materials to rebuild the Six Paths of Reincarnation, why don't they come here to get it?" Bai Muye asked while comprehending the laws of this world.
"Maybe they don't dare to come?" Wen Jun said with some uncertainty, "Don't you realize that there is no life in this world?"
"Yes, it's true that you can't feel it, but that doesn't mean it doesn't exist." Bai Muye replied.
In this high-latitude world with no concept of time, no one knows how long it has passed, maybe a long time, maybe just a moment.
When the scene of this world finally changed in front of their eyes, several people... were all a little stunned.
They were standing on a busy street. The street was bustling with traffic and people. Various aircraft were constantly flying over in the sky, and countless cars were speeding by on the ground.
There are many tall buildings on both sides.
"This is... the human world?" Wenjun frowned.
"Illusion." Bai Muye said, and a rune flew out of his body, quickly flew to the sky, and instantly magnified to the point of covering the sky and the sun.
boom!
Everything, all disappeared.
Then, their eyes suddenly changed, and they appeared in an extremely desolate desert.
Even his magic power seemed to be completely sealed.
The sun is scorching above my head, and the yellow sand is boundless under my feet.
Bai Muye continued to break with runes.
Afterwards, various civilized scenes and various worlds appeared in front of everyone like a revolving lantern.
When Xiaobai destroyed dozens of scenes in succession, his eyes returned to the colorful scene before.
"This..."
Even Bai Muye was a little speechless.
The laws of this world are so strange!
He finally understood why the demon from outside the territory didn't come here.
Are there any living beings here?
According to the laws of the human world, there should be no such thing.
